exposure: 22 surgical procedure types according to International Classification of Diseases, Ninth Revision criteria
cohort: Hospitalized patients undergoing various surgical procedures
finding: SSI rates in Turkey were generally higher than CDC NHSN rates and similar to INICC rates across various surgical procedures.
mod_finding: The SSI rate for cesarean section was 3.0%, higher than the CDC NHSN rate (1.8%) but lower than the INICC rate (not specified).
